title: The Time Value of Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2608.13297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In evolutionary search, a weak child can be a valuable ancestor that makes high-fitness regions reachable. Immediate-return control is blind to this delayed utility, penalizing mutations through their immediate offspring even when they open productive future lineages. We formalize this hidden dynamic as the time value of evolution within a finite-horizon Markov decision process. To exploit it, we introduce Lineage-Value Policy Gradients (LVPG), a long-horizon actor-critic framework for automated trading policy discovery. Our architecture decouples search control into specialized policy heads over a shared generative backbone: a bootstrapped critic head estimates the value of finite-horizon lineage potential from multi-step mutation trees, while an actor head dynamically modulates mutation intensity over the remaining search budget. We isolate the impact of long-horizon credit assignment against immediate-return optimization across 90 pai

translated_abstract: 在进化搜索中，一个弱小的后代可能成为有价值的祖先，使高适应度区域变得可达。即时回报控制对此延迟效用视而不见，它会通过即时后代惩罚突变，即使这些突变开启了富有成效的未来谱系。我们将这一隐藏动态形式化为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程中的进化时间价值。为了利用这一点，我们引入了谱系价值策略梯度（LVPG），这是一个用于自动交易策略发现的长期演员-评论家框架。我们的架构将搜索控制解耦为共享生成骨干上的专门策略头：一个自举评论家头从多步突变树估计有限时域谱系潜力的价值，而一个演员头在剩余搜索预算内动态调节突变强度。我们在90对配对实验中隔离了长期信用分配与即时回报优化的影响。
tldr: 本文提出谱系价值策略梯度（LVPG）框架，通过将进化中的延迟效用形式化为有限时域MDP，利用长期信用分配改进自动交易策略发现，显著优于即时回报优化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Lineage-Value Policy Gradients (LVPG), which formalizes delayed evolutionary utility as a finite-horizon MDP to leverage long-horizon credit assignment for automated trading policy discovery, outperforming immediate-return optimization.
